correctness.rationale: Outside edge ab in L(K_n) has exactly d_H(a)+d_H(b) selected neighbors; the only one-neighbor obstruction is the coexistence of degree-zero and degree-one root vertices. Nonspanning minimal forts must be proper cycles, spanning minimal forts minimal edge covers (spanning star forests); component exponential formula and degree-one/isolate inclusion-exclusion give both exact polynomials for all n>=2. The factorial-dominated proper-cycle sum controls M_n(1) and star-forest estimates are asymptotically smaller. An independent direct outside-neighbor enumeration for n=2,3,4,5 recovered 1,4,45,828 forts and 1,3,11,60 minimal forts; n=4 had 3 size-two forts and four proper triangles, n=5 had 40 minimum size-three forts. Finite checks corroborate, not replace infinite argument.

value.rationale: Two complete cardinality enumerators and the exact minimal-obstruction classification for triangular graphs J(n,2) are natural zero-forcing invariants that allow downstream count and hitting-set computations; not merely the known minimum scalar. The labeled-star-forest versus proper-cycle dichotomy is structural and mathematically motivated.

limitations: Only ordinary forts in J(n,2), n>=2; no general J(n,k) or other forcing variants
Independent brute force checked n<=5 only; infinite claims rely on symbolic proof
